name: animated-modal
title: Animated Modal
description: A dark rounded dialog with a bold trip heading, a stack of tilted travel photos and a short details list. It opens from a tilted, shrunken pose over a dimmed blurred page.
use: A short focused flow, like confirming a booking, needs to interrupt the page without leaving it.
avoid: The footer is clipped in the recorded demo, and nothing handles Escape, which keyboard users expect.
a11y: No Escape handling, no focus trap, and the close button is an unlabelled X; the entry spring ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded dialog over a blurred black backdrop, with a small close X in its top corner. A bold white heading sits above four overlapping tilted photos, with a two-column list of short trip details beneath.
behaves: Clicking the white trigger button dims and blurs the page, then the panel springs in from a tilted, smaller pose. The close X or a click outside dismisses it, and the page unblurs.
customise: Compose Modal, ModalTrigger, ModalBody, ModalContent and ModalFooter with your own content and classes. The spring, 3D tilt, blur and overlay are fixed.
weight: light: A single spring-animated panel and blur overlay; no canvas or loops.
